targets.expr: label_replace(sum(increase(storsafe_events_total{server=~"$server",severity="critical"}[24h])) or vector(0), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(storsafe_events_total{server=~"$server",severity="error"}[24h])) or vector(0), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(storsafe_events_total{server=~"$server",severity="warning"}[24h])) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(storsafe_events_total{server=~"$server",severity="informational"}[24h])) or vector(0), "k", "3", "", "")
